reason_for_new_protocol: V1 root succeeded but successor preparation was delayed until after settlement by a separate model/tool turn. V2 keeps the already-authored root/child policy in one timed direct-MCP handoff attempt.
scope: Root plus first checkpoint-linked successor; a failed or absent successor remains trial evidence, not NAV-EQ acceptance
clock_rule: Use the published resident client tick and floored resident monotonic milliseconds; world tick is only the frontier freshness clock.
handoff_rule: After the root admission, immediately obtain fresh perception and the retained successor context within the same timed orchestration call; submit a child only with the exact verified checkpoint, predecessor hash, current authority and a new frontier.
watermark_rule: Root committed-through unit 226 after a 125-tick route; child earliest action may not precede the predecessor committed boundary. Measure any idle gap rather than inferring overlap from admission.
stop_criteria: Hazard or entity in the fresh route window
claim_ceiling: At most first successor handoff qualification; three successors, both interruption paths, reconnect, explicit revoke and stale denial remain separate NAV-EQ requirements.
